game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Icefall Ladder, ladders up an icefall: the avalanche scout must handle crevasse ghouls while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Key Checkpoint: Check key membership with in before reading dictionary values.
theme: Frost Peaks – Icefall Ladder: ladders up an icefall
core_gameplay_loop: In Icefall Ladder, repeat each round: Check key membership with in before reading dictionary values. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the checkpoint value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the flag pole using at most 17 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The flag pole reached with actions_used <= 17.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 17 before the flag pole is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 7 (applied tier): Key Checkpoint
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Key Checkpoint' (Week 8 slot 11), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Icefall Ladder'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how checkpoint changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against crevasse ghouls in Icefall Ladder.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The flag pole reached with actions_used <= 17.
